subject: June performance funnel readout — latency / cost / uptime / usage
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-30T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: June performance funnel readout — latency / cost / uptime / usage

Team —

Attached is the compact KPI funnel snapshot for June (attached PDF + dashboard image). High-level takeaways:

- Latency: median p95 increased ~12% month-over-month on long-tail batches (>1k tokens). Root cause appears tied to a small spike in large-context inference requests from a single partner integration.
- Cost: overall token cost down 6% due to expanded caching on hosted tiers, but Dedicated margins tightened because of underutilized reserved capacity on weekends.
- Uptime: platform uptime stayed at 99.96% but we saw two short outages in ap-south region (3–5m each) — postmortem underway.
- Usage: daily active API keys grew 18% (healthy), but average tokens per request skewed up — correlates with latency rise.

Three suggested immediate actions (owners please ack):
1) Short-term: throttle/batch policy change for the partner sending large contexts (owner: Jonas).
2) Weekend capacity optimization for Dedicated pools to reduce wasted reserved GPU hours (owner: Markus + Finance).
3) Uptime: finalize ap-south postmortem and a quick mitigation for the networking flakiness (owner: Vivek + Infra).

Please review the dashboard snapshot and the suggested owners. If any of you want a deeper metric breakout (quantization deltas, per-model kv-cache hit rate, per-customer request-size distribution) flag it here — I can pull the CSVs.

Attachments: 202806-KPI-funnel.pdf, dashboard-snapshot-202806.png
Drive snapshot: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c-kpi-funnel-snapshot

Thanks —
Sergio Alvarez
Director, Partnerships (acting)
Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai

Acknowledged — quick updates and proposed micro-plan: 

1) Partner large-context spike
   - Initial mitigation: enforce a soft cap at request size 1200 tokens with transparent 429 + Retry-After header (ships in next deploy window: 48h).
   - Data task: I will produce per-customer long-request histograms (weekday vs weekend) by EOD tomorrow.
   - Attachment: quantization-impact-deltas.csv (shows cost difference and token inflation across 3 model families).

2) Dedicated weekend optimization
   - Proposal: schedule a weekend auto-scale-down policy for non-critical pools (saves ~18% reserved GPU hours). Markus, can you confirm risk appetite?

3) Uptime/ap-south
   - Vivek: root-cause looks like intermittent packet loss on a third-party transit link. Short term: reroute critical egress during peak windows. I opened infra ticket INFRA-2028-247.

Action owners and short timeline:
- Jonas: per-customer histograms + soft cap rollout (48h)
- Markus: confirm weekend auto-scale policy and finance impact (72h)
- Vivek: ap-south reroute + postmortem (24h)

Attachment: quantization-impact-deltas.csv

Thanks all — appreciate the quick turn. Final confirmations: 

- Jonas: proceed with soft cap rollout in the next deploy window. Please include the 429 policy doc and a short customer-facing note for Maria and Procurement so Acme can understand the temporary throttling behavior.
- Markus: coordinate with Finance on the proposed weekend auto-scale and share expected $ savings vs SLA risk by Thu EOD.
- Vivek: prioritize the ap-south reroute and share remediation ETA in INFRA-2028-247 (I want a mitigated path within 24h).

Maria — looping you in so Acme has visibility. If the soft cap will affect any of your production customers, please reply with which services and we will prioritize exempting critical keys during the pilot.

I'll assemble a one-page exec brief for the QBR pack once we have the concrete numbers from Jonas/Markus/Vivek — target: Friday COB.

Best —
Sergio
